posts.title: Size Inclusive Sustainable Fashion Brands
posts.description: After talking to Louis and Emi about fashion over the past few months, I decided it was time to put together a list of all the sustainable fashion brands that I can find that are size inclusive (minimum 3XL).

posts.title: Interrogate Your Boundaries More Often! A Rant
posts.description: There’s been something bothering me about the way we talk about tech and privacy lately. posts.title: In Brightest Day, In Darkest Night
posts.description: Heya! It’s been a brick since I’ve posted. Not because I haven’t wanted to. Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave has a stranglehold on me and I don’t think it will be done for….years. I have so much I want to talk about with this game….but I want to wait till I’ve finished all 4 storylines and digested it. As an Edelgard-stan, Theodora’s story really drew me in. Moreso that I think her story is a classic
